orgEngineTab.intro: Choose which query engine this organization runs on. The deployment decides the engine kind ({{engine}}); this choice decides whose coordinator answers your queries.
orgEngineTab.modeShared: Shared — the pooled engine Provisa operates
orgEngineTab.modeSharedHelp: The default. Your queries run on the multi-tenant coordinator, isolated by catalog and role.
orgEngineTab.modeIsolated: Isolated — a dedicated engine Provisa operates for this organization
orgEngineTab.modeIsolatedHelp: A coordinator reserved for this organization alone. No other tenant's work shares its resources.
orgEngineTab.modeIsolatedUnavailable: This deployment cannot provision a dedicated coordinator, so an isolated engine is not available here.
orgEngineTab.modeExternalHelp: Point Provisa at a {{engine}} coordinator you run. Data planning stays in Provisa; execution lands on your cluster.
orgEngineTab.applyNote: Saving rebuilds this organization's runtime immediately. Queries in flight finish on the previous engine.
